channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Navigating uncertainty: Federal Reserve's rate cut amid data shadows and policy fractures
item.description: As Powell navigates dissents and data deserts, the Fed's post-meeting statement and projections will crystallize whether 2026 dawns with easing or endurance. Watch for upward GDP revisions and sticky inflation dots; they portend a pause that could redefine the soft landing.

item.title: J&K Congress disowns SC Dept chief Karan Bhagat amid 'unauthorized' event
item.description: A major rift erupted within the J&K Congress after the party disowned SC Department chairperson Karan Bhagat for organizing an "unauthorized" event attended by senior leaders Vikar Rasool Wani and Tina Choudhary. Bhagat hit back at JKPCC chief Tariq Hamid Karra, accusing him of "soft separatism" and lacking understanding of Congress culture.

item.title: J&K LG hands over jobs to 82 beneficiaries; says 'terror ecosystem being dismantled' in J&K
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha on Thursday handed over appointment letters to 41 next of kin of terror victims, 22 age-relaxation beneficiaries, and 19 wards of J&K Police martyrs, fulfilling long-pending commitments to 82 families.

item.title: Gaurav Khanna's birthday: BB19 winner gets emotional as young fan gifts him bouquet at Siddhivinayak Temple
item.description: On December 11, he visited Mumbai's iconic Siddhivinayak Temple to seek blessings. Making the moment even more special, he was joined by fellow contestants Pranit More and Mridul Tiwari.

item.title: Smriti Mandhana moves on after cancelling wedding; Palash's alleged fling shares first statement amid trolling
item.description: Indian cricketer Smriti Mandhana, after ending her relationship with composer Palash Muchhal, made her first public appearance since the breakup. She said cricket remains her greatest love and the Indian jersey her biggest motivation, helping her set aside personal struggles and stay focused on her life and career.

item.title: PM Modi announces Rs 2 lakh ex gratia for kin of victims in Andhra bus tragedy
item.description: In a message shared by the Prime Minister's Office on X, he expressed deep grief over the incident and extended condolences to the bereaved families. "Pained by the loss of lives due to a bus mishap in the Alluri Sitharama Raju district of Andhra Pradesh. My thoughts are with the affected people and their families during this difficult time. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured," the PMO posted.

item.title: Gold edges up, silver slips after record high
item.description: "MCX Gold has broken out to lifetime highs, trading near Rs 1,32,776 inside a tightening ascending wedge with firm support at Rs 1,31,400," analysts stated.

item.title: Rupee slides over weak global cues, FII outflows
item.description: The strong demand for the US currency is adding to the pressure on the rupee. At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 90.43 against the dollar and soon dropped to 90.56.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open higher on hopes of India–US trade deal
item.description: The positive sentiment strengthened further after Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with US President Donald Trump on Thursday, with both leaders discussing ways to boost economic ties as officials continue negotiations on a trade agreement.

item.title: Reddit files High Court challenge against Australia's under-16 social media ban
item.description: In filings lodged in the High Court of Australia on Friday, Reddit claimed that the social media restrictions are being inaccurately applied to the platform because it is primarily a forum for adults and does not have 'traditional' social media features that the government has taken issue with.
